notes.title: v. 0.4.0 Replays
notes.notes:
[b]Rico-Jump is back![/b]
With this update, a new mechanic is introduced: [b]Replays![/b]
For any entry in the global leaderboard you can now replay their run and see for yourself, how they achieved their times! Simply right-click on the leaderboard to show your mouse and then click the 'R'-icon next to the respective leaderboard entry.

Further, as I now moved everything to Unreal Engine v5.1.1 and made some changes to the map, the leaderboards were reset. Hence, from now on, every entry will have a replay attached to it.

Further fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed crash when switching levels
[*] Fixed rare crashes when returning to main menu
[*] Overall refactoring of the code to fix some technical dept
[/list]

[u]Next steps:[/u]
Next, I will work on the Map-Editor, to make it more user-friendly and easier to use.

notes.title: v 0.3.1
notes.notes:
This is a smaller update to address the few reviews Rico-Jump got stating it might be a crypto-miner, which is utter nonesense.
However, I can understand where this comes from, as the GPU-usage is always >90% while playing Rico-Jump.

The reason for this is simple, I disabled V-Sync, which results in your GPU pushing as much frames as it possibly could. Hence, the high GPU-usage. As I developed Rico-Jump with the Counter-Strike movement in mind, where more FPS equals better, I disabled it.

To prevent more negative reviews stating this nonesense, I enabled V-Sync now as default. This should lower the GPU-usage drastically.
However, this only applies to new installments. Consequently, if you already have Rico-Jump installed, simply check the V-Sync box under the graphical settings to reduce the GPU-usage.

notes.title: Tier 3 - Wallrunning
notes.notes:
Tier 3 is now available and introduces a new mechanic: [b]Wallrunning![/b]
Use the walls to your advantage by running along them and increasing your speed by jumping from them.
Three new levels await you in the new Tier 3 to practive and show off your wallrunning abilities.

Further, new achievements have been added for all new levels of Tier 2 and Tier 3.

A bug causing lag on multiplayer sessions should be resolved.


[b]What's next?[/b]
Alongside smaller bugfixes, my main objective for the next big update will be the map-editor.
Among other things, this will include an improved usability, duplication of items and a list of items currently spawned into the map. With that, the process of creating your own maps should be improved massively.

notes.title: Tier 2: Bunny-Hopping
notes.notes:
[h1]Tier 2 is out now![/h1]

New mechanic: [b]Bunny-Hopping[/b]

With version 0.2 of Rico-Jump a new mechanic is introduced: [u]Bunny-Hopping[/u].
Alongside it, Tier 2 is now available with 4 brand-new levels. These new levels serve as a tutorial to introduce the new mechanic.
Bunny-Hopping is a hard to master skill, but can accelerates your robot significantly if pulled off correctly.

For now, Bunny-Hopping is only available in Tier 2.

[b]What comes next?[/b]
In the near future I will introduce another new mechanic and finish Tier 2, which then will also comprise a total of 9 levels.
Afterwards, I will put all efforts into improving the Map-Editor, making it easier to build and publish your own maps to the Steam Workshop.
